email_link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link:
email_footer_account: You are getting this message because you have an account on {siteName} ({siteUrl}). It is a service message about your account or listing, not an advertisement. Questions: {contactEmail}. {controllerName}.
email_footer_requested: You are getting this message because someone entered this email address on {siteName}. If it was not you, you do not need to do anything: nothing will change. Questions: {contactEmail}. {controllerName}.
email_invite_preheader: Set a password and edit your listing.
email_invite_body_1: an administrator of {siteName} has created an account for this email address. With the account you can edit your listing, post opportunities and confirm connections with other listings.
email_invite_body_2: To start, set a password. The link works for {expiry}.
email_invite_body_3: If you do not want an account, you do not need to do anything.
email_claim_preheader: Your organization is already listed. You can claim, edit or remove it.
email_claim_intro: {entryName} already has a listing on {siteName} ({siteUrl}). This message is only about that listing. We are not promoting anything and we ask for nothing except your decision.
email_claim_source_body: {importSource}. We hold: name, description, website, place, contact email and phone.
email_claim_changes_body: From now on we do not show your email address and phone number to visitors of the site. When you claim the listing, you choose what each field shows.
email_claim_actions_body: Claim the listing, then edit or remove it. Or remove it right now, with one click, without an account. The links work for {expiry}.
email_claim_nothing_body: We send you one reminder, then we do not write again. The listing stays with hidden contacts. If nobody claims it, it is archived automatically on {archiveDate}.
email_claim_notice_body: Controller: {controllerName}. Purpose: showing the listing in the public directory of {siteName}. Legal basis: legitimate interest in running a directory, with your right to object (Art. 6(1)(f)). Data: name, description, website, location, contact details. Source: {importSource}. Recipients: visitors of the site (except the hidden email and phone) and our service providers named in the privacy policy. Retention: until you remove the listing or it is archived as described above. You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object, and to complain to the Croatian data protection authority (AZOP, azop.hr). More: {privacyLink}. Questions and requests: {contactEmail}.
email_claim_closing: If you want no more messages from us, press "Remove my listing" or reply to this email. We will record your address so that we do not write to you again.
email_verify_preheader: One click and your request goes on.
email_verify_body_entry: you sent an application for the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. Confirm that this address is yours, and our administrators will review it.
email_verify_body: please confirm that this email address is yours for your account on {siteName}.
email_reset_preheader: A password change was requested for {siteName}.
email_reset_body_1: someone asked to change the password of an account on {siteName}. If it was you, choose a new password. The link works for {expiry} and can be used once.
email_reset_body_2: If it was not you, ignore this message. Your password stays the same.
email_reset_tip: Tip: a long password of at least 12 characters is enough, and it can contain spaces.
email_change_preheader: A new address for your account on {siteName}.
email_change_body_1: a change of email address was requested for an account on {siteName}. This address becomes the new account address only after you confirm it. The link works for {expiry}.
email_change_body_2: If it was not you, ignore this message. The account stays on the old address.
email_connection_preheader: You decide whether the connection becomes public.
email_connection_intro: {proposerName} proposes a connection with your listing {entryName} on {siteName}.
email_connection_visibility: Until you confirm it, the connection is visible only to you, the proposer and administrators. Confirm or decline it in your account. If you do nothing, the proposal expires after {days} days.
email_opportunity_approved_body_1: your opportunity "{opportunityTitle}" for {entryName} passed review and is now public on {siteName}. It is open until {expiresAt}.
email_opportunity_approved_body_2: Messages from interested people reach you through the contact form.
email_opportunity_rejected_preheader: See the reason and edit the text.
email_opportunity_rejected_body_1: the opportunity "{opportunityTitle}" for {entryName} did not pass review on {siteName}.
email_opportunity_rejected_body_2: You can edit it and send it for review again.
email_opportunity_removed_preheader: The reason and what you can do.
email_opportunity_removed_body_1: an admin removed your opportunity "{opportunityTitle}" from {siteName}.
email_opportunity_removed_body_2: If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email or write to {contactEmail}. You can also post a corrected opportunity from your account.
email_opportunity_reason_incomplete: The opportunity lacks information needed to publish it, for example a clear description of what you offer or seek.
email_opportunity_reason_duplicate: The same or a very similar opportunity already exists.
email_opportunity_reason_out_of_scope: This opportunity is outside what {siteName} covers.
email_opportunity_reason_unverifiable: We could not verify the details of the opportunity.
email_opportunity_reason_spam: The opportunity looks like spam or advertising.
email_opportunity_approved_body_auto: Your next opportunities are published without review.
email_claim_reminder_preheader: This is the last message about this listing.
email_claim_reminder_intro: A few days ago we sent you a message about the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. This is the only reminder and the last message about it.
email_claim_reminder_body: The listing is public, and we do not show your email address and phone number to visitors. The links from the first message work until {expiryDate}.
email_claim_reminder_closing: The full data notice is in the first message and at {privacyLink}. If you want no more messages, press "Remove my listing" or reply to this email. Questions: {contactEmail}. {controllerName}.
